Title: Weighted Walking Stick and Watenda LSJ

Messages.Author: librarian
Messages.Body:
Hi guys -

What happens when Watenda uses his special vs a Weighted Walking Stick?

Texts:

Weighted Walking Stick [CE:U, Third:U, LotN:PA3]
Cardtype: Combat
Only usable before range is determined on the first round.
Put this card on this minion and put 5 counters on this card. While in
play, this card represents a melee weapon (equipment) that does
strength+1 damage each strike. For each point of damage inflicted by
this strike (even if prevented), remove a counter from this card. Burn
this card when it has no counters. A minion can have only one Weighted
Walking Stick.
Artist: Thomas Nairb

Watenda [AH:V3, CE:PM]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Malkavian
Group: 2
Capacity: 3
Discipline: obf
Camarilla: Once each combat, Watenda can cancel the effect of a combat
card the opposing minion plays by burning an amount of blood equal to
the blood or pool cost of the card. If the card is a strike card, the
opposing minion chooses a new strike.
Artist: Terese Nielsen

best -
